title: [CSS 2025 additions] writing-mode (writing-mode)
body:
<!-- solid-native-css-baseline:2025:writing-mode -->
## Goal and exact scope

Implement **writing-mode** (WebDX ID `writing-mode`) for **only the 2 CSS compatibility keys that first reached Baseline between 2025-01-01 and 2025-12-31**. Earlier keys belong to the 2024 backlog; 2026+, limited-availability and Chrome-only additions are excluded.

This extends a group already represented in the [2024 ticket](https://github.com/RoboXGamer/SolidNativeZigExperiment/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20in%3Atitle%20%22%5BCSS%202024%5D%22%20%22(writing-mode)%22). Coordinate implementation, but do not repeat or close that ticket's older requirements here.

## Current implementation status

**Needs a current source audit.** The previous audit targeted 2024 and does not establish completion or exact missing/partial behavior for these newer keys. Check the latest implementation and box/sizing changes; record concrete supported paths and gaps before claiming support. Merely exporting a value or accepting a style field is insufficient.

## Required work and acceptance

- [ ] Implement valid syntax, typed specified/computed values, invalid-value handling and applicable cascade/inheritance rules.
- [ ] Connect the computed result to the real native layout/paint/semantic consumer with dependency invalidation.
- [ ] Cover authoring/bridge/native behavior, precedence/defaults and reactive changes against the pinned keys and specification.
- [ ] Cover every eligible key/value/context in the table, with invalid and negative cases where applicable.
- [ ] Name related 2024 foundation tickets and concrete external dependencies; keep unavailable behavior explicitly open rather than silently dropping it.
- [ ] Record applicable specification/WPT fixture IDs and a fixed browser/platform/font/DPI oracle where relevant.
- [ ] Exercise the native authoring -> bridge -> computed style -> layout/paint/state path, including changes and disposal.
- [ ] Record implementing commits and actual executed verification. Respect any active testing pause; unexecuted fixtures are not passing results.

## Eligible 2025 additions

| Compatibility key | Baseline newly available | Chrome metadata |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `css.properties.writing-mode.sideways-lr` | 2025-03-31 | 132 |
| `css.properties.writing-mode.sideways-rl` | 2025-03-31 | 132 |

Area: **styling**. WebDX groups: `css`. Current specification pages may include newer additions; this table is the ticket's date-limited denominator, not a claim of measured conformance.
